item.title: RESOLVED: Users will be unable to provision new resources
item.description:
SERVICES/COMPONENTS AFFECTED:
- IBM Cloud

IMPACT:
- VPC and Classic Production workloads are not expected to be affected
- Users may be unable to provision new Classic resources or make changes to existing Classic resources
- IBM Cloud recommends delaying any updates or modifications to Classic resources on our platform while the emergency maintenance is in progress

STATUS:
- 2026-10-22 15:13 UTC - RESOLVED - Maintenance activities have been completed. Resource management and provisioning in our Classic environment has been restored. Please contact Cloud support via the support case, if you are continuing to see issues and one of our engineers will be happy to assist. 
- 2026-10-22 12:10 UTC - MITIGATING - Maintenance activities are ongoing and on target to restore new provisioning and resource management in our Classic environment by 18:00 UTC. The next update will be shared in 4 hours or earlier if there is a material status change.
- 2026-10-22 07:47 UTC - MITIGATING - Maintenance activities are still in progress, and we are revising our target to restore new provisioning and resource management in our Classic environment to 18:00:00 UTC. We are being intentionally cautious with the implementation of the maintenance activities which has added some additional testing / validation steps before we deploy to production. The next update will be shared in 4 hours or earlier if there is a material status change.
- 2026-10-22 05:20 UTC - MITIGATING - Maintenance activities are progressing and we are targeting to restore new provisioning and resource management in our Classic environment by 08:00 UTC. The next update will be shared in 3 hours or earlier if there is a material status change.
- 2026-10-22 01:18 UTC - MITIGATING - The maintenance operation continues and we are now estimating 08:00 UTC to restore new provisioning and resource management in our Classic environment. We will provide the next update on progress in 4 hours or sooner, if there is a material change in status.
- 2026-10-21 20:40 UTC - MITIGATING - We are targeting to restore Classic provisioning within 8 hours while we complete the remainder of the maintenance operation in parallel. We will provide the next update on progress in 4 hours or sooner if there is a material change in status.
- 2026-10-21 18:30 UTC - MITIGATING - Our engineers are continuing to make progress on the emergency maintenance. Current impact is limited to new Classic resource provisioning and changes to existing Classic resources.
- 2026-10-21 17:00 UTC - MITIGATING - Impact to VPC provisioning has been mitigated.  The impact is now limited to new Classic resource provisioning and changes to existing Classic resources.
- 2026-10-21 16:45 UTC - MITIGATING - Impact to VPC provisioning has been mitigated.  The impact is now limited to new Classic resource provisioning and changes to existing Classic resources.
- 2026-10-21 15:15 UTC - IDENTIFIED - IBM Cloud are applying maintenance in our environment which may take functions like new provisioning and changes to existing resources, temporarily offline. Production workloads are not expected to be affected. If you experience any issues, please contact our support teams via the Support Center or at 1-800-426-7378.
